theorems_only_on_branches.name: field_operator_continuous
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ α] (op : FieldOperator α)   (field : ContinuumField α) (t : ℝ), Continuous fun x => (op.L field).φ x t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: indeterminacy_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ α] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ α]   (field : ContinuumField α) (a b t : ℝ), 0 ≤ indeterminacy field a b t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: superposition_principle
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ α] (field1 field2 : ContinuumField α)   (c1 c2 : ℝ), ∃ field3, ∀ (x t : ℝ), field3.φ x t = c1 • field1.φ x t + c2 • field2.φ x t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: uncertainty_relation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ α] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ α]   (field : ContinuumField α) (a b t : ℝ), indeterminacy field a b t * indeterminacy field a b t ≥ 0
